title: AtomMem: Building Simple and Effective Memory System for LLM Agents via Atomic Facts
abstract: arXiv:2606.19847v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning and generation abilities, but their fixed context windows limit long-term information accumulation and reuse across multi-session interactions. Existing memory-augmented systems often construct memory in a coarse and unstable manner, relying on inefficient memory representations or unstable unconstrained updates. To address these challenges, we propose AtomMem, a long-term memory system designed for value-dense storage and stable memory evolution. AtomMem introduces a Fact Executor, which selectively extracts high value atomic facts from long form interactions to serve as highly efficient memory representations. Subsequently, AtomMem organizes these facts into hierarchical event structures and temporal profiles, capturing coherent episodic contexts and tracking dynamically evolving user attributes over time. translated_title: AtomMem：通过原子事实为LLM智能体构建简单有效的记忆系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的推理和生成能力，但其固定的上下文窗口限制了跨多轮会话交互中信息的长期积累与复用。现有的记忆增强系统往往以粗糙且不稳定的方式构建记忆，依赖于低效的记忆表示或不稳定的无约束更新。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AtomMem，一个旨在实现高价值密度存储和稳定记忆演化的长期记忆系统。AtomMem引入了一个事实执行器，从长篇交互中有选择地提取高价值原子事实，作为高效的记忆表示。随后，AtomMem将这些事实组织成分层的事件结构和时间档案，捕捉连贯的情景上下文，并跟踪随时间动态演化的用户属性。在检索过程中，系统激活一个联想记忆图以……
tldr: 提出AtomMem长期记忆系统，通过事实执行器从长篇交互中提取高价值原子事实，并将其组织成分层事件结构和时间档案，为LLM智能体实现高价值密度存储与稳定的记忆演化。
en_tdlr: AtomMem is a long-term memory system for LLM agents that selectively extracts high-value atomic facts from long-form interactions and organizes them into hierarchical event structures and temporal profiles, achieving value-dense storage and stable memory evolution.
